questions.prompt: Are you married?
Are you filing jointly with your spouse?
What state do you live in?
What county do you live in?
How many people live in your household (incl. you)?
How many dependents do you claim on your tax return?
What is your age?
What is your spouse's age (if married)?
Do you own your home?
Do you rent your home?
Do you receive a W-2 paycheck from an employer?
Are you self-employed (Schedule C/E/F)?
How often are you paid? (weekly/biweekly/semimonthly/monthly)
How many vehicles do you own or lease?
Do you own any real estate (home, rental, land)?
Do you have a 401(k), IRA, or other retirement account?
Do you have life insurance with cash value?
Do you own stocks, bonds, or other investments?
Have you filed all required tax returns?
Are you currently in an open bankruptcy proceeding?
Have you filed bankruptcy in the past 7 years?
Are you currently a party to a lawsuit?
Have you defaulted on a prior IRS payment plan or offer?
For the last 5 tax years, did you file and pay the tax shown on time?
Have you had an income-tax installment agreement in the last 5 tax years?
Total amount owed to the IRS (all years, incl. penalties/interest)?
Income tax owed before penalties and interest?
Months remaining until the IRS collection statute expires (from transcript)?

next: A tax professional must review this result before anything is filed.
